body.name: Columnwise affine compatibility block
body.construction: For every \(j\in V\), set \(C_j=\operatorname{ch}_{G'}(j)\), \(R_j=\operatorname{de}_{G'}(j)\setminus C_j\), \(M_j=H[R_j,C_j]\), \(b_j=H[R_j,j]\), \(\mathcal A_j=\{x_j\in\mathbb R^{|C_j|}:M_jx_j=b_j\}\), and \(d_{ji}(x_j)=H[i,j]-H[i,C_j]x_j\) for \(i\in C_j\).
